senses.gloss: f.(b. h.;כום or כמם, cmp. Assyr. Kimmut, Rawl. Five Gr. Mon. ch. VII; Kimtu family, Schr. KAT2 p. 557) Kimah (gathering), a constellation, prob. Draco (not Pleiades).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 58b:14">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> (etymol. play) <he>כ̇מ̇אה̇ ככבי</he> as bright as a hundred stars.
Ib. 59ᵃ; Yalk. Gen. 56 נטל … מכ׳ וכ׳ the Lord took two stars away from K. and brought the flood &c.; R. Hash. 11ᵇ, sq.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:1:17">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> bot.
Num. R. s. 10 הדעת … ככ׳ knowledge is compared to the K … מה כ׳ מבשלת וכ׳ as the Kimah causes the ripening of the fruits and gives them taste, so does knowledge &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:6">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כ׳ מעדנת וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00153"><he>עָדַן</he></cite>; a. e.
